title: Multimodal LLM
description: Language model integrated with vision encoders to process both text and image modalities.
name: Multimodal LLM
summary: Multimodal LLMs (Vision-Language Models) project image tokens from a vision encoder (like ViT) into the text embedding space of a decoder language model, enabling reasoning across both text and visual inputs.
use_when: Building applications requiring image captioning, visual Q&A, or document extraction.
avoid_when: Working with text-only tasks where standard text decoders are faster and cheaper.
pros: Unified reasoning across image pixels and text strings.
Can analyze document structures, diagrams, and UI screenshots directly.
Zero-shot capability for visual classification and labeling.
cons: Image projections dramatically increase context window token consumption.
Very high memory footprint due to hosting both vision and text encoders.
Prone to visual hallucinations and spatial layout misinterpretations.

key_hyperparams.name: image_resolution
key_hyperparams.note: Resolution of input images fed to the vision tower. Higher values capture detail but cost tokens.
